test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the following statements regarding different modulation techniques:

1. In Amplitude Modulation (AM), the bandwidth of the modulated signal is twice the modulating signal frequency.

2. Frequency Modulation (FM) typically consumes less power than AM for the same coverage area.

3. Phase Modulation (PM) is equivalent to Frequency Modulation (FM) when the modulating signal is integrated before applying to the phase modulator.

Which of the above statements are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 3 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** In Amplitude Modulation (AM), the bandwidth of the modulated signal is twice the modulating frequency. This occurs because AM generates two sidebands (upper and lower) that are symmetrical about the carrier frequency, each occupying a bandwidth equal to the modulating signal frequency.
